newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton market closed on holiday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton market closed on holiday.

text.p: The private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) was closed on Pakistan's founder Mohammad Ali Jinnah's birthday on Wednesday, one broker said.
The association will also remain closed on Thursday due to a local religious holiday and Friday because of the weekend.
On Tuesday, the KCA's official spot rate for NIAB-78 variety closed at 2,377.50 rupees ($59.11) per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,570 and MNH-93 at 2,580.
